01

“But those who disbelieve are in pride”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
But those who disbelieve are in pride [Sad 2] meaning: "in rivalry."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي عِزَّةٍ [ص: 2] "، يَعْنِي: «مُعَازِّينَ»
Edition record 373201 · p. 572Link to report ↗
02

Explanation from Mujāhid 02

English
Transmission wording

مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَذَا فِي الْمِلَّةِ الْآخِرَةِ [ص: 7] يَعْنُونَ: «مِلَّةَ قُرَيْشٍ»

12

“And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body”

Four explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr, Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab and Nawf al-Bikālī.

13
Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body [Sad 34] He says: "a devil called Asif. Solomon said to him: 'How do you tempt people?' Asif said to him: 'Show me your ring and I will tell you.' When Solomon gave him his ring, Asif threw it into the sea. Solomon wandered off and his kingdom was gone, and Asif sat on his throne. God kept Asif from Solomon's women, and he did not approach them, but Solomon's mother did not recognize him. Solomon would ask for food and say: 'If you knew me you would feed me; I am Solomon,' and they would call him a liar. One day a woman gave him a fish to clean its belly for her, and he found his ring in its belly, and his kingdom returned to him, and Asif fled into the sea."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَانَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَى كُرْسِيِّهِ جَسَدًا [ص: 34] يَقُولُ: " شَيْطَانًا، يُقَالُ لَهُ آصِفًا، فَقَالَ لَهُ سُلَيْمَانُ: كَيْفَ تَفْتِنُونَ النَّاسَ؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ آصِفٌ: أَرِنِي خَاتَمَكَ أُخْبِرْكَ، فَلَمَّا أَعْطَاهُ سُلَيْمَانُ خَاتِمَهُ نَبَذَهُ آصِفٌ فِي الْبَحْرِ، فَسَاحَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَذَهَبَ مُلْكُهُ، وَقَعَدَ آصِفٌ عَلَى كُرْسِيِّهِ وَمَنَعَ اللَّهُ آصِفًا نِسَاءَ سُلَيْمَانَ فَلَمْ يَقْرَبْهُنَّ، فَأَنْكَرَتْهُ أُمُّ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَكَانَ سُلَيْمَانُ يَسْتَطْعِمُ، وَيَقُولُ: لَوْ عَرَفْتُمُونِي أَطْعَمْتُمُونِي، أَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ فَيُكَذِّبُونَهُ، فَأَعْطَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ يَوْمًا حُوتًا يُنَظِّفُ لَهَا بَطْنَهَا فَوَجَدَ خَاتَمَهُ فِي بَطْنِهَا، فَرَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ مُلْكُهُ، وَدَخَلَ آصِفٌ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَارًّا "
Edition record 373213 · p. 574Link to report ↗
14
Report from Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab 14

Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Ali ibn Zayd ibn Judan, from Said ibn al-Musayyab, who said:
"Solomon son of David withdrew from the people for three days, and God, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to him: 'O Solomon, you withdrew from the people for three days and did not look into the affairs of My servants, nor did you give justice to a wronged person against a wrongdoer.' Solomon's kingdom was in his ring; when he entered the bathhouse he would put it beneath his bedding. One day he entered the bathhouse and placed his ring beneath his bedding; the devil took it and threw it into the sea and sat in his seat on his bedding, and the people went toward the devil. Solomon came and began to say to the people: 'I am Solomon, I am the Prophet of God,' and they pushed him away. He begged with his palm for forty days. Then he came to the people of a ship and they gave him a fish; he cut it open and there was the ring, so he put it on. Then he came and took hold of the forelock of that
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، قَالَ:
" احْتَجَبَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ عَنِ النَّاسِ، ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ عز وجل إِلَيْهِ يَا سُلَيْمَانُ: احْتَجَبْتَ عَنِ النَّاسِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَلَمْ تَنْظُرْ فِي أُمُورِ عِبَادِي، وَلَمْ تُنْصِفْ لِي مَظْلُومًا مِنْ ظَالِمٍ، وَكَانَ مُلْكُ سُلَيْمَانَ فِي خَاتَمِهِ، وَكَانَ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْحَمَّامَ وَضَعَهُ تَحْتَ فِرَاشِهِ، وَدَخَلَ الْحَمَّامَ يَوْمًا وَوَضَعَ خَاتَمَهُ تَحْتَ فِرَاشِهِ، فَأَخَذَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَأَلْقَاهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ، وَجَلَسَ فِي مَجْلِسِهِ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ، وَأَقْبَلَ النَّاسُ نَحْوَ الشَّيْطَانِ، وَجَاءَ سُلَيْمَانُ فَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ لِلنَّاسِ: أَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، أَنَا نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ فَيَدْفَعُونَهُ، فَسَأَلَ فِي كَفِّهِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا، ثُمَّ أَتَى أَهْلَ السَّفِينَةِ فَأَعْطَوْهُ حُوتًا فَشَقَّهُ، فَإِذَا هُوَ بِالْخَاتَمِ، فَتَخَتَّمَ بِهِ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَأَخَذَ بِنَاصِيَةِ ذَلِكَ
Edition record 373214 · p. 574Link to report ↗

16
Report from Nawf al-Bikālī 16

Nawf al-Bikālī

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Abu Imran al-Jawni, from Nawf al-Bikali, who said:
"Solomon son of David used to take shelter with an old woman, and when he slept in the daytime, a white snake would come and keep [flies] off his face."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ نَوْفٍ الْبِكَالِيِّ، قَالَ:
«كَانَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ يَأْوِي إِلَى عَجُوزٍ، فَإِذَا نَامَ بِالنَّهَارِ جَاءَتْ حَيَّةٌ بَيْضَاءُ تَذُبُّ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ»

“gently [rukha]”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

17
Explanation from Mujāhid 17

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
gently [rukha] [Sad 36] he said: "The rukha is the pleasant."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
رُخَاءً [ص: 36] ، قَالَ: " الرُّخَاءُ: الطَّيِّبَةُ "

14

“wherever he directed”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Nawf al-Bikālī.

18
Explanation from Mujāhid 18

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
wherever he directed [Sad 36] meaning: "wherever he wished." And with the same chain, on His words: so give [Sad 39] he said: "give"; or withhold, without account [Sad 39] he said: "meaning without blame."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
حَيْثُ أَصَابَ [ص: 36] يَعْنِي: «حَيْثُ شَاءَ» وَبِإِسْنَادِهِ فِي قَوْلِهِ: فَامْنُنْ [ص: 39] قَالَ: أَعْطِ، أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ [ص: 39] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي بِغَيْرِ حَرَجٍ»

19
Report from Nawf al-Bikālī 19

Nawf al-Bikālī

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Abu Imran al-Jawni, from Nawf al-Bikali, who said:
"The devil who was given power over Job was named Mawsut."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ نَوْفٍ الْبِكَالِيِّ، قَالَ:
«كَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ الَّذِي سُلِّطَ عَلَى أَيُّوبَ، اسْمُهُ مَسُوطٌ»

15

“and Dhu al-Kifl”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

20
Explanation from Mujāhid 20

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and Dhu al-Kifl [Sad 48] he said: "Dhu al-Kifl was a righteous man and was not a prophet; he had undertaken to a prophet that he would manage his people for him and judge between them with justice; hence he was named Dhu al-Kifl."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَذَا الْكِفْلِ [ص: 48] قَالَ: «كَانَ ذُو الْكِفْلِ رَجُلًا صَالِحًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ نَبِيًّا، وَكَانَ تَكَفَّلَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَكْفِيَهُ قَوْمَهُ وَيَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْعَدْلِ فَلِذَلِكَ سُمِيَّ ذَا الْكِفْلِ»

17

“Did we take them in ridicule?”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

22
Explanation from Mujāhid 22

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Did we take them in ridicule? [Sad 63] He says: "did we miss them?"; or have [our] eyes turned away from them? [Sad 63]: "so that we do not see them."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
أَتَّخَذْنَاهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا [ص: 63] يَقُولُ: «أَخْطَأْنَاهُمْ» ، أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْأَبْصَارُ [ص: 63] «فَلَا نَرَاهُمْ»

18

“The truth [is from Me], and the truth I say”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn Jurayj.

23
Explanation from Ibn Jurayj 23

Ibn Jurayj

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ibn Jurayj, on His words:
The truth [is from Me], and the truth I say [Sad 84] he said: "He says: the truth is from Me, and the truth I speak."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَالْحَقُّ وَالْحَقَّ أَقُولُ [ص: 84] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: الْحَقُّ مِنِّي، وَالْحَقُّ أَقُولُ "
